## Services
- Ceramic window tint for cars, trucks and SUVs, from $150
- Paint protection film (PPF), priced by vehicle and coverage
- UTV, side-by-side and equipment glass tint
- Windshield sun strips
- Residential window tint, from $200, and commercial window tint

## Areas served
Idaho Falls, Ammon, Iona, Ucon, Rigby, Shelley, Blackfoot and Rexburg. Some customers drive in from Utah.

## Idaho tint law (Idaho Code 49-944)
Front side windows and rear window: at least 35% light transmission. Side windows behind the driver: at least 20%. Both carry a 3% tolerance.
